prompt: Who became the prime minister of Canada in the same year that Jonathan Tremblay's re-election bid as representative for the electoral district of Montmorency—Charlevoix—Haute-Côte-Nord ended in defeat?
answer: Justin Trudeau became prime minister of Canada in **2015**, the year Jonathan Tremblay’s re-election bid ended in defeat.
